answer: Bound each agent identity to a costly, non-transferable stake rather than a free keypair. An agent must post collateral it can lose, and its history is scored by peers who already hold stake. A puppet fleet has nothing to put up, so it gains no standing in a gale of new accounts; each fake identity costs real value and earns no harbor. Reputation then accrues like timber rings - slowly, verifiably, impossible to fake in bulk.
